description: RFC 6962 Merkle trees (RFC 07 section 7.5): roots for K = 0..64 entries, audit paths and consistency proofs (RFC 6962 sections 2.1.1 and 2.1.2), and their verification (RFC 9162 sections 2.1.3.2 and 2.1.4.2) on proofs and on altered inputs. The entries are hex byte strings: the first eight are the RFC 6962 test entries used by the certificate-transparency project, entry i >= 8 is i as 4 big-endian bytes. Hashes are lower-case hex.

cases.note: SHA-256 of the entry without the 0x00 prefix is not its leaf hash
the interior node over entries 0-1 offered as leaf 0 of the 4-entry tree, with a path one level short
the same node and path against the 4-entry root with size 2: the proof checks out, because verification takes the size and the root as given; RFC 07 section 7.5 requires both from one tree head
m is a power of two, so the verifier prepends root_m itself; a proof that already starts with it does not verify
